claim_boundary.reason: The checklist gates partner evidence acceptance only. It does not authorize model claims or production scoring.

items.acceptance_criterion: partner_source_manifest.json and all ten evidence CSV files are present.
items.label: Required package files
items.partner_fix: Supply partner_source_manifest.json and all ten evidence CSV files.

items.acceptance_criterion: Every source hash has reviewed owner, dataset, license scope, date range, reviewer, and evidence package metadata.
items.label: Source manifest governance
items.partner_fix: Map every source_ref SHA-256 to owner, dataset, license, date range, reviewer, and evidence package.

items.acceptance_criterion: Every evidence CSV meets its minimum reviewed-row floor.
items.label: Evidence row sufficiency
items.partner_fix: Fill every evidence CSV with enough reviewed rows to meet the row floor.

items.acceptance_criterion: Required distinct, temporal, elevation, and slope coverage floors pass for every evidence group.
items.label: Spatial, temporal, numeric coverage
items.partner_fix: Broaden station, region, scene, case, time, elevation, or slope coverage where required.

items.acceptance_criterion: Every row is fresh, reviewed, license-supported, SHA-256 referenced, and mapped to the source manifest.
items.label: Review freshness, license, and source controls
items.partner_fix: Ensure every row is reviewed, fresh, license-supported, and linked to the source manifest.

items.acceptance_criterion: Independent holdout, scientist review, license clearance, and promotion attestations pass after evidence acceptance.
items.label: Release-gate attestations
items.partner_fix: Supply accepted holdout, scientist-review, license-clearance, and promotion attestations after evidence passes.

partner_next_actions: Supply partner_source_manifest.json and all ten evidence CSV files.
Map every source_ref SHA-256 to owner, dataset, license, date range, reviewer, and evidence package.
Fill every evidence CSV with enough reviewed rows to meet the row floor.
Broaden station, region, scene, case, time, elevation, or slope coverage where required.
Ensure every row is reviewed, fresh, license-supported, and linked to the source manifest.
Supply accepted holdout, scientist-review, license-clearance, and promotion attestations after evidence passes.
